items.title: Ran Blake interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 16, 2021
items.q: this is the memory of Barbara, Toots, Nellie, Thelonious, Nica, Charlie Rouse, so many people that love Monk.

ctx.x: And of course I don’t usually play this so briefly but immediately and of course the lights are on, I’m with Monk Rowe, Aaron’s here, my wonderful cat DekTor Dutra! on my right, but that was “Barbara Monk.” Sometimes I pop to other Monk songs but this is the memory of Barbara, Toots, Nellie, Thelonious, Nica, Charlie Rouse, so many people that love Monk.
You’re very into dynamics and setting up expectations and sometimes giving us what we might expect and then sometimes not. I especially like the part where it sort of eased into that nice waltz.
